description: Review of the commit that replaced the hand-written scope resolver with the languages' own tooling: the file declares `# -*- coding: latin-1 -*-` (PEP 263) and holds a Latin-1 byte, so Python decodes it as Latin-1, not as the UTF-8 saidvsdid reads. A file whose declared encoding is not UTF-8 is not analysed: one file-level WARN, and the `@pytest.mark.skip` it adds is a WARN (it may skip), never FAIL. The real runner skips the test.
